message:
I remember the time we had an unexpected power outage right in the middle of dinner. There I was, trying to juggle a half-cooked casserole and a flashlight that was seemingly powered by the last light of a dying star! I fumbled around for our lantern, only to find it was hiding behind the vacuum cleaner — great place for it, right? 

After a good laugh and a quick scramble for our trusty power bank to keep the phones charged, I realized how unprepared I was for the simple things, like having a few backup lights easily accessible. 

Now, I keep a little ‘power outage kit’ ready to go, so I can embrace the cozy chaos next time without the comedy routine. What’s your favorite tip for staying comfortable during a blackout?
